app.name: Kinlock
app.tagline: Money that can only reach the school or landlord it was meant for.

common.notImplemented: This page is not built yet.
common.usdOnlyNote: No reliable exchange rate is available for this currency, so only the USD amount is shown.
common.rateRiskNote: Exchange rates change. The local-currency amount is an estimate and is not guaranteed.

request.title: Create a payment request
request.intro: Create a link that fills in the sender's form with your details, the amount and the payment schedule.
request.noAuthority: The link only fills in the form. It can't move money: the sender still reviews and signs everything.
request.payeeNone: No verified payees are available right now.
request.indexerDown: The list of payees can't be loaded right now. Try again in a minute.
request.referenceHint: For example an invoice or student number. Anyone with this link can see it; on chain it is stored only as a hash.
request.errorAmount: Check the amounts: use numbers like 150 or 150.25, with at most 7 decimals.
request.errorDate: Choose a date for every payment.
request.errorOrder: Payments must be in date order.
request.errorGeneric: The link couldn't be created. Check the details and try again.

claim.title: Claim a payment
claim.loading: Reading this payment from the blockchain…
claim.notFound: No payment with this number exists on the blockchain.
claim.readFailed: The payment couldn't be read from the blockchain. Check your connection and try again.
claim.expiresLabel: Unclaimed money can be refunded to the sender from
claim.referenceMatch: The reference in this link matches the payment on the blockchain.
claim.referenceMismatch: Warning: the reference in this link does NOT match this payment. Check with the sender before releasing.
claim.referenceMissing: This link has no payment reference, so it can't be checked. Ask the sender for the full claim link.
claim.wrongAccount: This wallet isn't the payout account for this payment. Connect the payout account shown above to claim.
claim.errorNotUnlocked: This payment can't be claimed yet.
claim.errorExpired: The claim period has ended; the sender can now get a refund.
claim.errorAlreadyReleased: This payment has already been claimed.
claim.errorPayeeNotActive: This payee is not active right now, so payments can't be claimed. Contact your attester.
claim.errorTx: The transaction didn't go through (it may have been declined in your wallet, or your account can't receive this asset yet). Nothing was paid; you can try again.
claim.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Nothing was paid; you can try again.
claim.otherAsset: Asset contract (not the configured USDC — check before claiming)

claimLinks.heading: Your saved claim links
claimLinks.intro: Claim links are kept only in this browser. Kinlock has no copy, so export them and keep the file somewhere safe.
claimLinks.empty: No claim links are saved in this browser.
claimLinks.unavailable: This browser isn't letting Kinlock save anything (for example in a private window). Copy each claim link and keep it yourself.
claimLinks.confirmRemove: Remove this claim link from this browser? If you haven't sent it to the payee or exported it, it can't be recovered.
